The unit is unusually sensitive to mirror, rotate_180 and patch_shuffle (percentiles 0-3), so it needs upright, side-specific head/body configuration, and small or distant animals in the near misses get only about 2.
parsed.missing_data: Activation-maximizing crops or masked tests separating fur texture from head and ear shape, plus mirrored versions of the top photos to see which facing direction it prefers.

CPSN_s3.explanation: The unit responds to furry fur on the side or back of a mammal's head, such as the cheek, ear or neck. It fires most for dogs and wild canids, and more weakly for other furry mammals like monkeys, hamsters, squirrels, hyenas and mink. It seems to prefer one left-right layout, where the fur sits to the left of a face that extends to the right.
